title: Secret Bars and Favorite Spots Walking Tour in Philadelphia
requirements: Infants are required to sit on an adult’s lap
Not recommended for travelers with spinal injuries
Not recommended for travelers with poor cardiovascular health
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
No children or persons under the age of 21 allowed
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb: Looking for a fun night out exploring Philly's best kept secrets? Join our 'Secret Bars and Favorite Spots' tour! We'll visit 4-5 unique bars, including a hidden speakeasy or secret bar—places even many locals don't know about. This is a bar-hopping experience focused on enjoying the present-day atmosphere and discovering local favorites. Please note: This is not a historical tour. While we'll be in an area with rich history, our focus is on the bar scene and creating a fun social experience. We look forward to having a great time with you, and please drink responsibly.
